round5Status: Fixed: the mention's own attempt queued past a lease is resumed (fallback row, event published); the drain releases on its own context; a keyed repeat records its new claim; a held-lane test with a real refresh tick and a negative control; a Retry while attempt 1 is queued supersedes attempt 1 and leaves one copy. The PR body names the order risk across a rolling update or a kill, as the architect asked. Migration 0145 follows main's 0144 and every reference says 0145.

keyFindings.description: MentionResumedSQL (via mentionAttemptPastClaimLapseSQL) and MentionAbandonedSQL both miss an attempt that a later attempt overtook while its lane still holds and refreshes its claim, so MentionLiveSQL counts it live for as long as the lane is held. After a Retry that fails within the first lease, the outbox defers the comment's comment.created every 2 s until the lane supersedes attempt 1: every destination of the comment waits minutes, against the one-lease bound stated in publisher.go:299-302, outbox/mentions.go:24-26 and 36-41, model.go:1313-1314, AGENTS.md and the changelog. Reproduced by an overlay test. Fix: a pending attempt older than a lease and not abandoned is resumed, whoever holds it; add the reproduction as a test.

claimFallbackCopies runs its autocommit claim on the pass's ctx; a context cancelled after the statement commits returns context canceled, the pass returns with no records, and the claimed rows stay claimed for claimWindow (1 minute), contrary to the documented release at once on a stop. It makes TestAClaimantWhoseResentMentionFailsStillHearsTheComment fail intermittently (eventDeliveries cancels its outbox in the tick the fallback pass claims), a flaky required test. Run the claim on context.WithoutCancel(ctx) with a timeout, as the record step does.

Prose: 'the lane's own send settles the row' (AGENTS.md:1423, comment_mention_sender.go:108) - the fallback pass settles it; AGENTS.md:1405-1406 is garbled; cmd/dispatch/README.md:1311-1314 describes the 0145 rows as only the sweep's resend, not a send still queued past a lease; AGENTS.md:3513-3519's MentionLiveSQL wording must match finding 1's fix.
